messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: PDR-789 fired -> severity: P1. Alert: CUDA_ALLOC_FAILED spike across us-west-2-gpu-pool-12. 93% GPU mem util on 3/6 hosts, KV cache evictions rising. Metric links: https://grafana.redwood-inc.com/d/abcd/gpu-pool?orgId=1

pagerduty: Incident PDR-789 paging oncall Sam O (primary)

Sam O: Acked. I'm on it. Pulling logs now, almost 1:1 with kvcache evictions.

Sam O: running quick checks: `ssh gpu-host-12 'nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used,memory.total --format=csv'` and `kubectl -n inference logs -l pool=us-west-2-gpu-pool-12 --tail=200 | grep -i oom`

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook: GPU OOM surge playbook -> https://wiki.redwood-inc.com/runbooks/gpu-oom-surge. Steps: 1) Evict KV cache on hot hosts 2) Remove bad replicas 3) Route to fallback quantized models 4) Scale up temporary nodes if autoscaler fails.

Sam O: Evicting KV cache on host gpu-host-12 now. Command: `curl -XPOST https://admin.redwood-inference/api/pools/us-west-2-gpu-pool-12/evict-kv`

Sam O: paste logs after evict: evicted_keys=41234, reclaim_mb=5120. mem util dropped from 97% -> 72% on gpu-host-12. One host still stuck at 98%.

Maya L: I see autoscaler attempted to spin but quota check failed on cloud account, so the pool stayed saturated. Filing cloud quota request now.

Jordan K: I can spin a temporary replacement VM, will attach to pool with driver 515.76. Requesting 2-min window to patch and join.

pagerduty: Noted. If not resolved in 10min, will escalate to infra-leads.

Sam O: Temporary mitigation: shifting 20% traffic to fallback model small-quant-7b. Using control plane API:

```
curl -XPOST https://api.redwood-inference/control/routing -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' -d '{"pool":"us-west-2-gpu-pool-12","route_override":{"percent":20,"model":"small-quant-7b"}}'
```

Traffic reroute applied. Latency for those requests increased ~30ms but success rate improved.

CS-Ops: Noted customer impact. Seeing ~4-6% errors for onboarding customers on us-west-2 region. Status page updated: https://status.redwood-inference.com/incident/PDR-789

Sam O: For the host still at 98% I restarted the inference-worker process gracefully: `systemctl restart inference-worker` on gpu-host-14. Post-restart memory stable at 65%. No OOMs since restart.

Jordan K: Temp node provisioned and joined pool in 3m, driver patched. Pool capacity nominal. Autoscaler bug tracked as GH#4567.

Maya L: I've opened cloud quota ticket CCed to infra oncall. Also created an alert to detect autoscaler quota failures separately.

Sam O: Summary so far: evicted kv cache, restarted stuck worker, routed 20% to fallback quantized model, temp node added. Error rate down from 6% -> 0.8%. Latency back towards normal.

Lee H: Taking handoff at 15:30 PT for next 2 hours. I will keep monitoring GPU mem and autoscaler ticket. Leaving notes: evicted_keys and temp node id node-uw2-temp-03.

Sam O: Thanks Lee. If mem pressure resurfaces, revert routing and we'll re-run full eviction sequence.

incident-bot: PDR-789 status updated -> acknowledged by Sam O, current status: mitigated, monitoring. Will auto-resolve if no regressions in 30m.

Lee H: will keep watch and close after 60m stable.

CS-Ops: Replied to affected customers with mitigation summary and ETA for follow-up.

pagerduty: Incident PDR-789 will auto-resolve at 3512346150 unless further alerts occur.
